summary: Master priority management with proven frameworks. Learn workload assessment, stakeholder communication, and strategic planning to boost productivity.
lede: Priority management helps team leaders, project coordinators, operations supervisors and executive assistants rank competing work against available capacity. Training covers urgency and impact assessment, dependency mapping, capacity planning and workload sequencing, with practice building priority registers, time-blocked calendars, delegation plans and Kanban boards. Learners use frameworks such as the Eisenhower Matrix, ABCDE and MoSCoW, and apply Outlook Calendar and Microsoft Planner or an equivalent task platform to make assignments, progress and capacity conflicts visible.
audienceIntro: Priority management training suits professionals who coordinate competing commitments, assign work, or report delivery risks. It supports foundation to intermediate learners who want a repeatable method for making daily, weekly, and project priorities visible.
prerequisites: Prior experience managing workplace tasks, meetings, deadlines, or team requests is useful but not mandatory. You should bring three to five representative work activities, a typical weekly calendar, and access to a laptop. No coding or programming is required. Advanced digital workflow and AI-assisted task features are introduced at conceptual and operational levels, while priority analysis, scheduling, delegation, and review artefacts receive hands-on practice.
